cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(embeddedlib_external_smoke LANGUAGES C)
if(NOT DEFINED EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR is required")
endif()
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_library(embeddedlib_project_options INTERFACE)
target_compile_features(embeddedlib_project_options INTERFACE c_std_11)
add_library(embeddedlib::project_options ALIAS embeddedlib_project_options)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/foundation_status" foundation_status)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/numeric" numeric)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/byte_fifo" byte_fifo)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/first_order_filter" first_order_filter)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/moving_average" moving_average)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/hysteresis" hysteresis)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/deadband" deadband)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/rate_limiter" rate_limiter)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/pid" pid)
add_subdirectory("${EMBEDDEDLIB_SOURCE_DIR}/libraries/cascaded_pid" cascaded_pid)
add_executable(external_byte_fifo_smoke main.c)
target_link_libraries(external_byte_fifo_smoke PRIVATE byte_fifo first_order_filter moving_average
    hysteresis deadband rate_limiter)
target_link_libraries(external_byte_fifo_smoke PRIVATE cascaded_pid)
target_compile_features(external_byte_fifo_smoke PRIVATE c_std_11)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME external.byte_fifo COMMAND external_byte_fifo_smoke)
